      The one step people don't expect

      Sampling loops back until it's right. Production doesn't start until it does.

      Design and sampling aren't sequential — they're a loop. Staged sample rounds (T0, T1, T2) feed back into engineering until the physical object matches spec. A golden sample is signed off as the standard every production unit is measured against.

            Start smaller than a quote

            Sample the idea before you order the batch.

            Any factory in our network can build a single sample of your actual product — not a preset box — for a sample development fee, credited in full against your order. You hold the real thing in two to three weeks, before a single unit is batch produced.

            Honest frame: a single sample usually means digital print or a placeholder finish. Techniques like embossing or screen printing only become available at production scale — we tell you exactly which is which when your sample arrives.

              Why China, done right

              The capability is real. So is the risk. We exist to hold the second part down.

              China remains the deepest manufacturing base in the world for tooling speed, component sourcing, and factory capacity — across categories from injection molded plastics to precision electronics assembly. That's exactly why the horror stories exist alongside it. The risk was never the country: it's going in without vetting, without contracts, and without inspection standards, and finding out too late.

              Risk → Control

              Every failure mode has a control. We run all of them.

              Already picturing a specific worst case? Pick it — we'll jump straight to the answer.

              Design theftA factory copies your product and sells it themselves
              NNN agreement. Non disclosure, non use, non circumvention, drafted for enforceability in Chinese courts, signed before any file moves. Disclosure is staged: tooling partners get manufacturing files, not your go to market plan.
              01Concept & ID
              CUSTOM+ only — no factory involved yet.
              Mutual NDA in place before your first file is shared with us.
              02DFM
              CUSTOM+ engineering only — still no factory access.
              Working files stay inside the studio while the design is being made manufacturable.
              03Factory sourcing
              Shortlisted factories see general capability specs — not your full CAD.
              Quoting happens on dimensions and materials, not a complete file a factory could reproduce.
              04Tooling & sampling
              The selected factory gets manufacturing files — split across suppliers for multi part assemblies where practical.
              NNN agreement signed before this handoff — the actual moment of risk, so it's the actual moment the contract activates.
              05Production
              Same vetted factory, ongoing relationship — not a new party seeing the design for the first time.
              The NNN's non circumvention clause is what stops a sell direct move at this stage specifically.

              A Western NDA alone is commonly not enforceable in Chinese courts — that's exactly why an NNN, drafted for Chinese jurisdiction, is the actual instrument, not a formality.

              Fake factoriesThe "manufacturer" is a trading company with no production floor
              Factory audits. Equipment, floor capacity, and category experience verified on site or by a third party before any factory reaches your shortlist.
              Illustrative example — not a real factoryDOSSIER #SAMPLE 04
              Business license
              Verified against local registry, on file
              Export history
              7 years, 40+ SKUs shipped internationally
              On site audit
              Completed — floor walked, not a video call
              Floor capacity
              6 injection molding lines, 3 currently free
              Category experience
              Consumer electronics enclosures, 5+ years
              Financial stability
              No red flags in trade reference check

              This is the shape of what gets checked before a factory reaches your shortlist — illustrative formatting, not a real audit.

              Quality driftThe approved sample doesn't match what arrives at volume
              AQL inspection. IQC, IPQC and FQC checkpoints during the run, with statistical sampling against the golden sample, not just one glance after thousands of units are already boxed.

              The golden sample — the exact unit you physically approve — is photographed, measured, and kept as the permanent reference every later batch is checked against. This is the report format each batch gets measured with:

              Illustrative example — report format, not a real runAQL REPORT #SAMPLE
              Inspection level
              General Level II, ANSI/ASQ Z1.4
              AQL
              Critical 0 · Major 2.5 · Minor 4.0
              Sample size
              80 units drawn from a 2,000 unit batch
              Defects found
              Critical 0 · Major 1 · Minor 3
              Result
              PASS — within agreed threshold
              Sign off
              Inspector initialed, dated, photos attached
              Hidden costsChange orders appear once you're financially locked in
              Everything in writing. Tooling ownership, amortization, mold maintenance responsibility, and unit cost breakdowns agreed before production starts.
              GhostingThe factory goes quiet the week before a shipment is due
              We hold the relationship. You're never in a direct, unmediated relationship with the factory floor. Ghosting a studio with an ongoing pipeline is a different risk calculation than ghosting one client.
